lines.t: Was that the boulder at the lower passage? Felt it in my teeth! The lower galleries are open, then.
Go careful. The coil crew's down there, and whatever they're doing, the stone doesn't like it.
That's my Pebbles! Look at her, fat as a cushion. At least they fed her. Strange lot.
Every one of the crew's kin, home and grumbling. The Miners' Guild pays its debts — take these, and no arguing.
The assayer says those samples ring true — the stone's healthy under all that coil-rot. Best news this month.
Four samples, four clean notes. Now I can prove to the Guild the Undertone's still singing underneath.
Silver Chimes from the Guild store, and your fee. You've earned the both of them.
A sample! Let me tap it — ting. Clean. That's one. Three more, hiding where the crystal grows thickest.
Number two. Ting! Lovely. You've an eye for a glint, you have.
Three! Ting. One more and the Guild can stop worrying. Well — worry less. They're the Guild.
The fourth! Ting — oh, that's a sweet one. Talk to me again, I need a moment with it.
Four samples: two in the upper galleries — far north-east and down the south tunnels — and two below.
Below, try the south-west crystal hollow and the deep north drift. They glint when you're close. Bring them one at a time.
Pebbles hasn't left my boot since you brought her up. The crew's calling you 'the Tuner who knocked'.
Our kin've gone wandering since the hum dropped. Can't find their way up. Lower galleries are boulder-blocked.
And while you're poking about — the Guild wants crystal samples, four of 'em, to prove the stone's still sound.
My Rollith's back! Rolled straight into my shins. Best bruise I've ever had.
You got past the boulder? Then you've seen the coil crew. Big fellow in charge — ex-quarry, by the look of his hands.
They've a siphon clamped on the lower stone, north-west. That's where the hum went. I'd bet my lamp on it.
My Rollith's never wandered in her life. The hum stopped, and off she went, like she'd lost the way home.
Engineers went down past the passage before the boulder settled. Funny timing, that.
Kin all home, stone humming again. I might even go back to complaining about normal things. Like my knees.
See the old brass lift by the east gallery? Hasn't run since the hum dropped. Needs a buzz in its lode.
Spark it with an electric kin and it'll carry you to the upper ledge. Somebody stashed Chimes up there. Wasn't me.
A crate down there says 'Strays — to the Stillhouse'. So where's the Stillhouse, and what else is in it?
If a Larkhollow kin went missing, I'd start asking that question very loudly.
Forty years underground. You learn the stone's voice like your mother's. And right now it's whispering.
There's a cracked wall at the south end, too. Daylight behind it — the old tunnel to Brackenridge. A stone kin could shove it.
There. It'll stay open for good. Catch a stone friend when you can — the wild's full of them.
Lower galleries are west. Mind the coil crew. They'll ask you to keep two metres back. Politely. Repeatedly.
Stone glyph. It won't answer until you carry a Keynote tuned to stone. Rootloft's Cantor gives those out.
Stone glyph. Needs a stone voice to shift it. I can lend you one if you're short.
That glyph wants a stone voice. Not carrying one? I'll lend you mine — just this once.
Coil crew seven. Please keep a two-metre clearance from live equipment.
Right. I'll… log that as a delay.
We don't *take* kin. We collect strays. There's a difference. There's a form for it.
Is this about the coil? Everyone's always upset about the coil.
Well, that wasn't in the risk assessment. The Warden's just past the pen. He'll want a word. Several.
Honestly? I joined for the helmet. It's very warm.
Coil's three-quarters full and here comes a kid with a troupe. Course you do.
It's a job, kid. Quiet pays better than rock. Now move, or I'll move you.
…Magister won't like this. Neither do I, much.
Behind Brann, a neat fenced pen. A dozen miners' kin blink out at you — clean, fed, and very lost.
We didn't take 'em. They wandered in lost. We fed 'em. Paperwork says 'hold for safekeeping'.
A crate by the pen is stencilled: STRAYS — TO THE STILLHOUSE.
Take the miners' lot back up. The rest go to the Stillhouse. That's procedure. …I don't write procedure.
Brann unhooks the pen gate and looks away. The miners' kin trot past you toward the upper galleries, humming.
Up-shaft's unlocked. Comes out in Sallowfen. Vey's lot are out there fitting a bell. You'll hear Vey before you see her.
And kid — the Stillhouse isn't a place you find by asking. Keep your ears open.

Right. I'll… log that as a delay.

…Magister won't like this. Neither do I, much.
Go home. Get warm. Leave the stone to people who know what they're doing.
